status: Current Hug/SIMS model; supersedes the threshold-based batch 8 for new experiments.
source: Byte-preserved local hug-clay/clay_model.py and the four Cooke & van der Elst (2012) fitted coefficient rows.
initial_state: Kelvin strain is zero. Retained strain is 0.002 times the centered first coordinate of the batch-7 seeded starting array. Its population mean is zero. Elastic strain initially balances the neighbor springs.
interaction: sigma = external_load - K L gamma; gamma = sigma/G_M + Kelvin + retained. K=2 G_M, with batch-7 maximum-degree-normalized symmetric L. The interaction is a proposed SIMS rule; material fits do not calibrate this network.
solver_control_selection: First seed, every graph and material row, each with DOP853 and Radau; split at both load jumps.
numerical_method: Exact affine evolution of the two Burgers internal states in each Laplacian mode, using a symmetric similarity transform. No fixed time step.
measurements: Absolute strain spread and spread normalized by gamma_star=stress*100/eta_M; signed response unanimity uses +/-0.02 gamma_star. A shared positive load makes positive signs expected and is not evidence of voluntary agreement. Permanent mean strain, finite-time residual spread and internal relaxation are reported separately.
archive_policy: Keep the old 384 threshold-based Hug trajectories and tests as labeled historical controls; do not relabel them as clay results.
scope: Four frozen fitted parameter sets under chosen initial retained patterns and a new coupling law. Internal stresses can differ from the nominal row stress. No fit to collective clay samples, interpolation across the four material rows, large-deformation contact, venting or opening threshold.
